chapter: Learning, lawn parties and band rivalries
title: Cutting the titles off the music to stop a copier at Hunts and Nagel's
summary: At Hunts and Nagel's with Joe Oliver, a man copied titles of their third-grade sheet music, so Willie Foster had the titles cut off; Allen adds the 'Who Struck John' story.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: And he had a good band. Uh huh. And them fellas, uh, Robichaux had a, what you call a reading band. Uh huh. All good musicians in his band. Sight readers. And, uh, uh, uh, when I was playing with, uh, with, uh, what you call him, uh, Joe Oliver, we playing at Hunts and Nagel on Ray's.

in Alverville, we used to buy that third grade music, we had a gate on the side of the door leading to the music stand and the Roe Show, he would, now that's what you call stealing, he'd come through that side door and come up and stick up on top by the music stand and when we'd be playing a new number he didn't know nothing about, he'd get over there and try to catch the title of it, you see, and if he'd get the title you'd see him writing down, he's gonna get that, and well we used to get some nice third grade music, we used to pick out, what's called, Joe used to pick out good numbers, you see, so we caught on to that, Willie, Willie Foster, violin player, he told you all, he said, the Roe Show's catching all the titles of our numbers, there's something ought to be done about that, so he said, well we're gonna fix him now, we're gonna cut the title off, we're gonna cut the title off the music, you see, and he'd come up there the next week, he'd come up there peeping for, and he couldn't see no title, we would play the numbers, but the title was off, you see, well, what's the name of that piece of the offer, I don't know,

Who Struck John? Did you ever hear that? Who? Who Struck John? Yeah. A friend of mine used to go up and listen to Joe, I hope I need to ask him the name of a number, he'd say, Who Struck John? Yeah. He'd ask him the name of the next number, he'd say, Who Struck John?
